# make-a-dmg

> make-a-dmg is a free, single-file command-line tool that turns any macOS .app
> into a polished, drag-to-install .dmg. It uses only tools that ship with macOS
> (hdiutil, osascript, sips, iconutil) - no Homebrew formulae to depend on, no
> create-dmg, nothing to install. MIT licensed.

## What it does

- Builds the classic drag-to-install window: the app on the left, an
  /Applications shortcut on the right, laid out and saved into the dmg.
- Reads the app's own icon and sets it as the disk icon automatically; a custom
  icon can be supplied as .icns or PNG.
- Backgrounds from an image (crop / contain / stretch / window fit modes) or
  from a bare hex colour like 1e1e1e - no image editor needed. @2x artwork is
  kept at double resolution and 144 dpi so it stays sharp on retina screens.
- Window size, icon size, and exact icon positions are all settable.
- Optional Developer ID signing (--sign), opt-in and never automatic, with
  identities that cannot satisfy Gatekeeper clearly flagged.
- Optional SHA-256 checksum written beside the dmg (--sha256).
- A guided wizard (-i) asks about every option; -y runs fully unattended for
  CI; --no-window skips Finder styling on headless build servers.

## Install

- Website: https://make-a-dmg.kodeelite.com
- Run once, nothing installed: bash <(curl -fsSL kodeelite.com/dmg)
- Homebrew: brew install azharbinanwar/tap/make-a-dmg
- Source: https://github.com/azharbinanwar/make-a-dmg
- Requirements: macOS only. Zero dependencies beyond macOS built-ins.

## Comparable to

Covers the common use of create-dmg, appdmg and dmgbuild, but as one
dependency-free bash file that can be piped from the web, with signing,
retina backgrounds and a test suite built in.

Made by Kode Elite. Written by Azhar Ali (github.com/azharbinanwar).
